Starlink helps education

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-20T14:56:59+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2123792729130041703; média: videó, 46 másodperc]
SpaceX has donated 1,600 Starlink kits to help connect some of Paraguay's most remote schools to high-speed internet 🇵🇾

And the rollout has already reached a major milestone!

COPACO has completed the first phase, connecting 800 schools across Paraguay, and has received another 400 Starlink kits for the next phase

Here's where things stand:

• 800 schools already connected
• 400 additional kits received for phase two
• Another 400 planned for the final phase
• 1,600 schools targeted in total
• Hospitals and Family Health Units are also part of the broader connectivity plans

The rollout is reaching communities where traditional broadband has struggled for years

In the Chaco region alone, 95 schools have been connected, including schools serving Indigenous communities

Every installation undergoes a 60-item quality inspection, and even the antenna mounts are being manufactured by inmates trained through Paraguay's Ministry of Justice workshops

For thousands of children growing up in remote communities, this means access to online education, digital learning materials, and opportunities that were previously out of reach

This is exactly the kind of impact Starlink was built to deliver

Connecting places the rest of the internet infrastructure never reached
